title: Regulation of XPG-DNA damage binding dynamics by pre- and post-incision nucleotide excision repair factors and EXO1
authors: Muniesa-Vargas A; Ribeiro-Silva C; Geverts B; Davó-Martínez C; van de Grint J; Ganpat M; Thijssen KL; Pothof J; Houtsmuller AB; Theil AF; Vermeulen W; Lans H
one_liner_zh: 该文通过活细胞成像研究NER中XPG核酸酶与DNA损伤的动态互作及调控，但对象为修复蛋白而非TF-DNA结合体系，且方法为实验成像而非AI或物理模拟，仅部分涉及蛋白-DNA动态机制。
abstract: The XPG endonuclease plays a crucial role in nucleotide excision repair (NER) and other genome maintenance pathways. Precise regulation of XPG recruitment and activity during DNA repair is essential to avoid erroneous DNA incisions and genomic instability. In this study, we employed live-cell imaging to investigate how XPG function is regulated during NER, focusing on its dynamic interactions with key factors involved in the pre- and post-incision steps. We found that TFIIH and XPA facilitate the recruitment and association of XPG with DNA damage, and that XPG localizes separately from TFIIH to UV-induced lesions. Furthermore, our results show that XPG’s dissociation from DNA damage is triggered by its own incision activity as well as by that of XPF. Additionally, the exonuclease EXO1 promotes XPG dissociation, likely by processing incised DNA, even in the absence of XPG-mediated incision. Our findings help to better understand the regulatory mechanisms that control XPG activity during NER and provide important insights into the complex dynamics of the repair process.
abstract_zh: XPG核酸内切酶在核苷酸切除修复（NER）及其他基因组维护通路中发挥关键作用。在DNA修复过程中，XPG的招募和活性的精确调控对于避免错误的DNA切割和基因组不稳定性至关重要。在本研究中，我们采用活细胞成像技术，探讨XPG在NER过程中如何被调控，重点关注其与切割前和切割后步骤中关键因子的动态相互作用。我们发现TFIIH和XPA促进XPG与DNA损伤的招募和结合，且XPG在紫外线诱导的损伤位点与TFIIH分别定位。此外，我们的结果表明，XPG从DNA损伤处的解离由其自身的切割活性以及XPF的切割活性触发。另外，核酸外切酶EXO1促进XPG解离，可能通过处理切割后的DNA实现，即使在缺乏XPG介导的切割情况下也是如此。我们的发现有助于更深入地理解NER过程中调控XPG活性的机制，并为修复过程的复杂动态提供重要见解。
